lyon-vercors-balcony-roads.slogan: A 273 km loop out of Voiron

sections.advice: This Pont-en-Royans village stop → Combe Laval balcony road stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.
